allowCase: fresh test directory stripped of inheritance via icacls /inheritance:r and granted only BUILTIN\Administrators (S-1-5-32-544) plus the current user; non-Mock Gateway started and served normally

scope: real-host allow/deny verification of the G2 minimal gate; does not close the physical Mac-Windows W3 hardware gate (#15) nor authorize real Harness/long-lived credentials before G2 review
cleanup: all scenario directories and child processes removed by the helper; no listener or lock left behind
